BEFORE THE BOARD OF REGISTRATION FOR
ARCHITECTS, ENGINEERS AND LAND SURVEYORS
In the Matter of )
)
MICHAEL J. WARD ) OAH No. 10-0455-AEL
) Agency No. 2010-0000836
)
BOARD’S DECISION AFTER REMAND
The Board of Registration for Architects, Engineers, and Land Surveyors, in accordance
with AS 44.64.060(e)(3), revises the disposition of the case.
Mr. Ward’s application for registration is GRANTED subject to his acceptance of the
following conditions:
1. Pursuant to AS -08.01.075(a)(7), Mr. Ward will be on probation through December 31,
2015;
2. During his probationary period, Mr. Ward shall report any arrest for Driving Under the
Influence (or similar offense), or any arrest for other driving offenses or alcohol related
offenses. This report shall be made to the board, in writing, within 15 days of the arrest;
3. If Mr. Ward is convicted of Driving Under the Influence or similar offense during the
probationary period, Mr. Ward’s registration as an engineer shall be summarily
suspended pursuant to AS 08.01.075(c) and AS 08.48.111.
If Mr. Ward does not consent to these terms in writing within 15 days, his application for
registration is denied.
All remaining portions of the attached proposed decision are adopted.
DATED this 2nd day of August, 2012.
By: Signed
Chairperson
Board of Registration for Architects,
Engineers and Land Surveyors
[This document has been modified to conform to the technical standards for publication.]
To the extent jurisdiction has not been retained by the Superior Court, judicial review of this
decision may be obtained by filing an appeal in the Alaska Superior Court in accordance with AS
44.62.560 and Alaska R. App. P. 602(a)(2) within 30 days after the date of this decision.
